row.notes: (log, String *out, penaltyType, ...) Localises the penalty type (<0x15) via key table 0x14584fa98: 0 lng_drive_through, 1 lng_stop_go, 2 lng_grid_penalty, 3 lng_penalty_reminder, 4 lng_time_penalty, 5 lng_warning, 6 lng_disqualified, 7 lng_inf_removed_from_formation_lap, 9 lng_tyre_regulations, 10..15 lap invalidated / penalised variants, 16 lng_did_not_finish, 18 lng_speed_limit_penalty; replaces [driver_surname], [number], [places]. Callers Sess_PenaltyLog_Print, HUD. Addon: penalty type ids = UDP penalty enum.
